consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the first set of the show was energetic and enjoyable, with standout performances from Phil and Bobby. While the second set had its moments, many felt it lost momentum compared to the first.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 33 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While there were many positive comments about the first set, the second set received mixed reviews, leading to a slightly above neutral sentiment.
